trust_decision.summary: How much route-matching work the server does for an unauthenticated lazy-route-discovery manifest request: the server itself expands every requested path into all its ancestor prefixes and matches each one (recompiling route regexes), and the URL-length cap only runs after the version check (framework mode) or not at all (RSC).

landing_point.why: The advisory names unauthenticated DoS through route matching; handleManifestRequest is the one unauthenticated server handler that splits a user query param into paths, expands ancestors and matches each, and sits next to the existing URL_LIMIT check.

Version-mismatch must still return 204 + X-Remix-Reload-Document, and multi-path eager discovery under the limit must keep working.
